rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for describing management or administrative responsibility.

example.english: They have executive responsibility and handle personnel and resource allocation every day.
example.traditional: 佢負責行政工作，成日要處理人事同資源調配。
example.jyutping: keoi5 fu6 zaak3 hang4 zing3 gung1 zok3 sing4 jat6 jiu3 cyu2 lei5 jan4 si6 tung4 zi1 jyun4 tiu4 pui3

rows.note: Use 高層 as the all-purpose choice for a senior company executive or manager.

example.english: Only an executive can approve this decision.
example.traditional: 呢個決定要高層先可以拍板。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 jiu3 gou1 cang4 sin1 ho2 ji5 paak3 baan2

rows.note: Use this common shortened form for an executive committee in an organisation.

example.english: The executive committee is meeting today to discuss next quarter’s activities.
example.traditional: 執委會今日開會，商量下季活動安排。
example.jyutping: zap1 wai2 wui2 gam1 jat6 hoi1 wui2 soeng1 loeng4 haa6 gwai3 wut6 dung6 on1 paai4

rows.note: Use this for an executive committee, especially in an association, club, or union.

example.english: The executive committee will meet next week to decide how to spend the membership fees.
example.traditional: 幹事會下星期開會，決定會員費點樣用。
example.jyutping: gon3 si6 wui2 haa6 sing1 kei4 hoi1 wui2 kyut3 ding6 wui4 jyun4 fai3 dim2 joeng2 jung6

rows.note: Use this for the government branch or organs responsible for administering and enforcing the law.

example.english: The executive branch is responsible for ensuring that the new law is enforced.
example.traditional: 行政機關有責任確保新法有效執行。
example.jyutping: hang4 zing3 gei1 gwaan1 jau5 zaak3 jam6 kok3 bou2 san1 faat3 jau5 haau6 zap1 hang4
